d: Russia is reportedly providing intelligence to Iran and its regional allies as attacks target Saudi Arabia’s oil and military infrastructure. An intelligence firm examined 40 missile and drone attacks against Saudi Arabia by Iranian-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen and militias in Iraq between July 1 and October 19, finding Russian government and military satellites orbiting above the targeted areas before and after every strike.
